description: The server cannot read the user's disk. This returns an upload id and the exact curl command that sends a local file (a mesh or picture) to it; run that command, then pass the id as the image or mesh of another tool. Uploads last 24 hours.

bytes.description: The file's size in bytes (ls -l or stat).

filename.description: The file's name with its extension, e.g. "chest.glb".

name: upload_file
title: Upload a local file
